_help: Each item in 'tracks' becomes a player on the page. Put the .mp3 in this folder and add an item: id (used in the link #t=<id>; letters, numbers and dashes), unit (number), unitTitle (optional, shown once per unit), title, subtitle (optional, e.g. 'Page 4'), file (the mp3 name in this folder). The 'example' list is ignored by the page - copy its items into 'tracks' as a model.
